verdict.rationale: Gitleaks is a documented headless CLI. It has `git`, `dir` and `stdin` scan commands that an agent can invoke directly, and it writes a JSON report (findings.json). Baselines restrict that report to new issues, and allowlists cut false positives, which helps an agent separate real findings to file as issues. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of report-format flags and exit-code semantics, a native issue-filing capability (gitleaks-action only comments on PRs and alerts listed accounts), and independent hands-on corroboration of agent-driven parsing.
